'''Dynamet General''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Founded as '''Mercy General''', it was [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] foremost center for research on rare neurological diseases such as [[Cathington's Disorder]], and was renamed after the [[Dynamet Corporation]] around around [[4050 BBY]] when the company donated a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the construction of a research wing devoted to curing the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. The hospital was destroyed in the [[destruction of Taris]] in [[3956 BBY]], and the area around it became known as the [[Sinking City]].

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], three hundred years after the hospital's destruction, the hospital had three total intact floors. The [[rakghoul]]s that lived in the region established a breeding ground in the hospital, and reacted violently to any intrusion. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Synoda]] sent a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] aligned individual to access medical records of the Tarisian people before Taris's destruction in order to collect research on [[Colu's syndrome]], a devastating cancer that effected only the descendants of the survivors of the Destruction of Taris.

By the time of the [[invasion of Taris]] in [[3642 BBY]], the Republic had cleared out the rakghoul nest in the hospital and planned to renovate it. However, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] forces sabotaged the hospital, infecting the still-intact [[kolto tank]]s with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul virus]].

==Behind the scenes==
The hospital appears in the [[2011]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is a general location and the player can receive several missions that lead them to the area.
